sources.coverage: 隔离文库的条目、分类、笔记、标签、创作者、附件及全表结构/清单

queries.sql: SELECT libraryID, type FROM libraries ORDER BY libraryID
SELECT itemID, itemTypeID, libraryID, key, synced FROM items ORDER BY itemID
SELECT collectionID, collectionName, parentCollectionID, libraryID, key FROM collections ORDER BY collectionID
SELECT collectionID, itemID, orderIndex FROM collectionItems ORDER BY collectionID, itemID
SELECT itemID, parentItemID, note, title FROM itemNotes ORDER BY itemID
SELECT it.itemID, t.name, it.type FROM itemTags it JOIN tags t ON t.tagID=it.tagID ORDER BY it.itemID, t.name, it.type
SELECT d.itemID, f.fieldName, v.value FROM itemData d JOIN fields f ON f.fieldID=d.fieldID JOIN itemDataValues v ON v.valueID=d.valueID ORDER BY d.itemID, f.fieldName, v.value

SELECT ic.itemID, ic.orderIndex, ct.creatorType, c.lastName, c.firstName FROM itemCreators ic JOIN creators c ON c.creatorID=ic.creatorID JOIN creatorTypes ct ON ct.creatorTypeID=ic.creatorTypeID ORDER BY ic.itemID, ic.orderIndex
SELECT itemID, parentItemID, linkMode, contentType, path, syncState FROM itemAttachments ORDER BY itemID
